Hi Maya — thanks again for chatting last week. We want to lock a virtual full interview loop (three panels + manager + exec) that can run in a hybrid slate pattern to accommodate your timezone.

Quick ask: are you available next Tuesday (Nov 2) or Thursday (Nov 4) for a ~4.5 hour window? We’re proposing a sequence that keeps domain/system interviews first, then cross-functional, manager, and a short exec touchpoint. We’ll keep 20–25 minute panels with ~10 minute buffer windows between sessions.

Draft timing (PDT):
- 09:00–09:25 — Systems & Architecture (Panel A)
- 09:35–10:00 — Product / Cross-functional (Panel B)
- 10:10–10:35 — Manager deep-dive (Laura)
- 10:45–11:10 — Exec touchpoint (short)
- 11:15–11:45 — Debrief / follow-up Qs (optional)

Attachments: resume (attached), draft scorecard, v1 agenda.

If Nov 2/4 don’t work, tell us two blocks (morning/afternoon in your local timezone) and we’ll re-sequence. Also let us know if you prefer a single continuous session or a split two-day run (we can do either).

Thanks — I’ll hold both days tentatively until we hear back.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
